what: The golden numbers a clean install must reproduce (eir:bootstrap --fresh --with-client-inputs --build --run-engines --verify). Each value was recomputed from the database by App\Services\Eir\BaselineService::goldenActuals(); --verify recomputes it and compares, to the cent for amounts and exactly for counts.
commit: b64ba30 (staging-governance, phase 1 of the Staging Module Specification v1, rebased on 5647b41)
database: maiic_ifrs9_base (run A); reproduced by maiic_ifrs9_base2 (run B)
note: Set from two fresh bootstraps of the merged phase 1 (staging-governance at b64ba30) from two clean checkouts into two empty databases, run side by side on 15 October 2026: run A set the values and run B reproduced all 76 to the cent. Approved by Edward Mazibuko on 15 October 2026. 35 values move: the ECL by stage, the discounted allowance, the Mega Farm provision, the month records and the loans discounted follow single-ladder staging, now the seeded default (the 31 December 2025 policy, matured loans counted from maturity); the EIR revenue figures follow that staging too. The revenue figures also include 5647b41 (the Stage 3 interest basis follows the stage at the start of the month, and the Stage 3 history books the allowance the net basis needs), which had not reset golden.json. One golden is removed: the count of September 2026 loans not discounted because no remaining contractual horizon is available is no longer produced. The other 42 (take-on, ledger, loan books, write-offs, the RBM return, the overdue-run comparison, the compliance register, the Mega Farm ledger ties, the EIR counts) do not move. Commit 60fa8d5 (an existing database keeps the staging it ran; four review fixes) changes nothing on a fresh database.
